case_title: ROBERTA MOORE VS. UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA RETIREMENT ADMINISTRTION

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-21-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MOORE, ROBERTA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA RETIREMENT ADMINISTRTION SERVICE CENTER THE UC REGENTS LIABILITY IS LIMITED BY THE LEGISLATURE TO BREACH OF STATUTORY DUTIES. HERE, PLAINTIFF CLAIMS HER RETIRMENT PLAN WAS NEGLIGENT IN FAILING TO SEND MAILED NOTICE OF A BANK CHANGE, BUT THERE IS NO CALIFORNIA STATUTE IMPOSING THAT AS A DUTY OF THE REGENTS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
